title: Calculate tea filling volume and reserve volume
goal: declares two functions that can be called separately, allowing one to use the return value of the other.
summary: function receives input using parameters, and then passes the result to the caller through return. The result obtained by calling the sub-function can continue to participate in the calculation of the outer function.
tasks: completes drinkVolume(cups, mlPerCup), receives the number of cups and the number of milliliters per cup, and returns the value multiplied by the two.
completes prepareVolume(cups, mlPerCup, spareMl). Give the first two parameters to drinkVolume, then add the spare milliliters spareMl to the result and return it.
parameters are all non-negative integers. Reserve both function names so that they can both be called independently.

example.note: exhibition panel is the sum of the width of each equal-width board and the total width of the splicing gap. displayWidth directly uses the return value of boardsWidth.

hint: The number of cups and single cup capacity are first passed to drinkVolume. The third parameter is the reserve amount, which is added after the result is obtained.
